ppet": "Absolutely YES — and this is the correct move.
From now on:
✅ The META-PROMPT itself becomes a project file
Just like your OS, CRF, Corpus, Loader, etc.
That means:

You NEVER paste it again

Every new chat inside your Project will auto-load it

It becomes part of the runtime environment

Your manifest will reference it

Your loader will mount it before the engines activate

This makes the system deterministic across chats — exactly what you’ve been trying to achieve.

✅ NEW CANONICAL FILE SET —"
